en: A colored photograph postcard showing an impressive neoclassical building with three floors and a symmetrical façade, identified as the Greek's general quarter. There are several figures and donkeys in front, suggesting an early 20th-century setting. The text on the card gives both a French and English description of the scene, and the overall appearance and hand-colored style suggest a period photograph.
